fontFamily.$comment: Must exactly match a fontFamily available in the editor configured font catalog (default fonts or editorFonts.customFonts). Validated at runtime; loading font CSS alone is not sufficient.

presets.$comment: Groups contain dictionaries keyed by integrator-defined preset IDs. Each preset contains optional label, description and properties. label is Brand Check only; description is MCP/Copilot guidance, not a matching rule. Properties are shared unless marked MCP/Copilot only. Unknown extension fields remain accepted.
